name: Fusion ViT
definition: A 16-layer transformer that takes concatenated encoded image patches from K views and performs all-to-all self-attention to fuse features, providing full context from all other views for spatial and context reasoning.
summary: Fusion ViT fuses multi-view features via all-to-all self-attention to resolve inconsistencies and capture long-range dependencies, distinguishing itself from standard methods by leveraging Transformer capabilities for global or pixel-wise context.
